sources.label: Itential Inventory Manager
sources.help: Discover get_inventories / describe_inventory and an inventory node reader. Export result.data; verify all pages.

sources.label: NetBox
sources.help: netbox_get_objects(dcim.devices); full records and count/next completion. IPv6 requires explicit mapping.

sources.label: Nautobot
sources.help: nautobot_get_devices MCP differs from REST: devices[] vs results[], address vs host. Enrich identity and prove page completion.

sources.label: Cisco Catalyst Center
sources.help: Discover catc_find / catc_describe_operation then catc_devices. Page exact scope; controller reachability is separate evidence.

sources.label: Cisco Modeling Labs
sources.help: Probe get_nodes_for_cml_lab vs older get_nodes; management endpoint enrichment required. Never import console/credential-bearing pyATS exports blindly.

sources.label: containerlab
sources.help: listLabs / inspectLab brief; select exact lab and inspect actual API wrapper. Never import Docker environment. Map kind explicitly.

sources.label: EVE-NG
sources.help: eve_list_nodes lab_path/page/page_size; verify has_next=false and total_count. Management endpoint enrichment required; console_port is not SSH.

sources.label: GNS3
sources.help: gns3_list_nodes project_id; management endpoint and OS enrichment required. node_type=qemu and console endpoints are not management facts.

sources.label: ServiceNow CMDB
sources.help: No verified CMDB reader in bundled MCP. Import authorized scoped Table API result[] or capability-probe a suitable read tool. Prove ACL-aware completion.

sources.label: OpsMill Infrahub
sources.help: get_schema then read-only query_graphql with explicit JSON projection. Schema-specific; TOON/has_more=null is not complete JSON inventory.

sources.label: IP Fabric
sources.help: Discover ipf_api_endpoint_search/details then api_invoke inventory table. Resolve concrete snapshot. SDK8 loginIpv4/loginIpv6 replaces loginIp.

sources.label: Forward Networks
sources.help: Explicit network, concrete processed snapshot and device names; get_device or approved structured export. Discover schema; NQE prose is not complete inventory.

sources.label: Structured inventory
sources.help: Explicit reviewed JSON records, or convert CSV/YAML/XML with a trusted local parser. No arbitrary raw configuration or credentials.

sources.label: Permitted REST export
sources.help: Use an explicitly authorized existing MCP reader/export with exact origin, TLS and pagination bounds. pyATS does not fetch arbitrary URLs.
